population.span: comparing two once-daily regimens of edoxaban with warfarin in 21,105 patients with moderate-to-high-risk atrial fibrillation (median follow-up, 2.8 years)

endpoint.span: The principal safety end point was major bleeding.

estimate.span: The annualized rate of major bleeding was 3.43% with warfarin versus 2.75% with high-dose edoxaban (hazard ratio, 0.80; 95% CI, 0.71 to 0.91; P<0.001)

ci.span: The annualized rate of major bleeding was 3.43% with warfarin versus 2.75% with high-dose edoxaban (hazard ratio, 0.80; 95% CI, 0.71 to 0.91; P<0.001)

analysis_set.span: Compare edoxaban versus warfarin for Adjudicated Bleeding Events during the on-treatment period in the Safety Analysis set.

treatment_strategy.span:
ARM: Warfarin/placebo edoxaban [ACTIVE_COMPARATOR] Warfarin tablets plus placebo Edoxaban tablets
ARM: high dose edoxaban/placebo warfarin [EXPERIMENTAL] Edoxaban tablets (60mg) plus warfarin placebo tablets

served_mismatch: Served number (HR 0.80, 0.71-0.91) matches the abstract for major bleeding, high-dose edoxaban (60 mg) vs warfarin. However the served analysis_set label 'intention-to-treat' is not supported: the registry states major bleeding was analysed in the Safety Analysis set during the on-treatment period. The served row also silently selects the high-dose arm of a three-arm trial; the low-dose (30 mg) arm HR 0.47 (0.41-0.55) is a separate comparison against the same warfarin arm.

candidate_rejections.span: 1.61% with low-dose edoxaban (hazard ratio, 0.47; 95% CI, 0.41 to 0.55; P<0.001)
candidate_rejections.why: Low-dose edoxaban arm (30 mg); not the arm the served row represents. Using both arms against the shared warfarin arm would double-count controls.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Randomised adults (>=21 y) with documented AF and CHADS2 >=2; moderate/severe mitral stenosis and mechanical valves excluded, i.e. non-valvular AF.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Subjects with moderate or severe mitral stenosis, unresected atrial myxoma, or a mechanical heart valve

notes: ENGAGE AF-TIMI 48. Abstract (records/2) is the preferred source; europepmc_core.json abstract is truncated before the bleeding result. Registry OUTCOME 8 ANALYSIS 0 gives the same result as 'Cox Proportional Hazard .80 (95% CI .707 to .914)' with 418/7012 vs 524/7012 major bleeds (high-dose vs warfarin, safety set). Major bleeding definition: ISTH-based with minor modifications (registry). Abstract rates for major bleeding are annualized; the '1.61% with low-dose edoxaban' figure printed in the bleeding sentence is as printed in the source.
